headline: World's First Enhanced Geothermal Plant Powers Up in Utah
meta_description: Fervo Energy's Cape Station in Utah is now selling 24/7 carbon-free electricity after being built in just 23 months.
summary_short: Fervo Energy's Cape Station in Utah has become the world's first enhanced geothermal power plant to sell 24/7 carbon-free electricity.
body:
Fervo Energy's Cape Station in Utah has become the world's first enhanced geothermal power plant selling electricity around the clock with zero carbon emissions. The facility was built in just 23 months, demonstrating the speed at which clean energy infrastructure can now be deployed.

In its first phase, Cape Station will reach 100 MW of capacity. This milestone represents a significant advance for geothermal energy, a renewable power source that operates continuously regardless of weather conditions—unlike solar or wind.

Enhanced geothermal systems represent a growing frontier in decarbonization efforts. By proving the concept works at commercial scale in Utah, Fervo has cleared a path for similar projects elsewhere, offering hope that baseload clean power can be delivered faster and more reliably than many expected.
